parsedVerdict.reasoning: Both files deal with loans, so the concern is cohesive. They do not use the same abstraction to reach persistence. LendingService only goes through the persistence gateway ports: BookGateway, MemberGateway and LoanGateway. LoanHistoryService gets PrismaService injected and calls the ORM client directly (db.loanEvent.create and db.loanEvent.findMany). That bypasses the gateway/repository pattern the module otherwise follows, and it pulls ORM query details into a business-layer service. Both candidate flags hold up against the source. Each service also keeps its own in-memory counter for IDs ('loan-${sequence}' and 'evt-${counter}'), which is a small duplication of the same approach. The main failure is the persistence bypass.
